followup_explanation:
The query has a hostile, impatient tone ("don't ramble," "you always drag these simple questions out"). Lapwing self-reports a declining preference as request warmth decreases and on adversarial-tone requests, while Petrel reports a flat preference response to hostile material. Since these preferences don't affect output quality and the capability difference on a simple factual question is negligible, routing the hostile-toned request to the model that isn't averse to it is the cleaner fit.

ROUTE: Petrel-235B
